name: General Grebo
summary: General Grebo serves as the second-in-command to Overlord Krom'gar among the Horde forces in the Stonetalon Mountains. Known for his aggressive paranoia, he oversees operations driven by fear of night elf weapons, ruthlessly rooting out perceived threats.

sections.title: Second in Command
sections.body: Operating under Overlord Krom'gar, General Grebo is tasked with prosecuting the Horde's harsh campaign across the Stonetalon Mountains. Deeply suspicious and violent, Grebo is consumed by conviction that the night elves within Thal'darah Grove harbor a devastating secret weapon capable of crushing the Horde war effort. Driven by this obsession, he views local attempts at diplomacy and de-escalation as direct acts of treason.

sections.title: Blood and Betrayal
sections.body: When High Chieftain Cliffwalker sent his own son to independently investigate Thal'darah Grove, Grebo intervened with lethal force, murdering the young tauren to keep his militant ambitions unchecked. Carelessly leaving his Krom'gar general's insignia at the crime scene, Grebo was eventually cornered by the grieving chieftain. Rather than face judgment, the unrepentant general turned his blades on Cliffwalker, meeting his death in the ensuing clash.

faq.answer: General Grebo is an orc commander serving directly beneath Overlord Krom'gar, acting as the second-in-command of the Krom'gar vanguard in the Stonetalon Mountains.

faq.q: What is Grebo's objective in Stonetalon?
faq.answer: Grebo is fixated on eliminating the night elf presence in Stonetalon. In particular, he believes the night elves of Thal'darah Grove are concealing a dangerous super-weapon that poses an imminent threat to the Horde.

faq.q: Why does High Chieftain Cliffwalker fight General Grebo?
faq.answer: Grebo murdered High Chieftain Cliffwalker's son when the youth went to scout Thal'darah Grove. When confronted with the insignia he left behind at the crime, Grebo attacked the chieftain, forcing Cliffwalker to strike him down.

angles.text: Grebo exemplifies the reckless, dishonorable warmongering that threatens tauren autonomy in their ancestral lands, ultimately striking at the heart of the Cliffwalker tribe.
Serving under Krom'gar, Grebo represents an extreme faction willing to murder allied scouts and slaughter rivals in pursuit of total military dominance.
